id.description: Group id referenced by services' parentId and by child groups' parent.

parent.description: Parent group id for nesting (arbitrary depth).

variant.description: Container type → official AWS group icon + color.

icon.description: Override the container's header glyph with a specific icon reference (e.g. 'Res_Amazon-Elastic-Kubernetes-Service_EKS-on-Outposts_48.png' to badge an 'EKS Cluster' group). Pass 'none' to show the label only (logical sub-groups like a Kubernetes namespace).

pill.description: Small secondary label rendered as a pill in the group header, beside the title (e.g. an instance type 'ml.g6.24xlarge', a count '4x L40S', or a status 'privado'). Use for the sidecar/qualifier that shouldn't crowd the main label.

pillOverlay.description: When true, the group's `pill` is drawn as a solid colored tag inlaid in the container's top border line (con18 style), instead of inline in the header row. Good for an instance type badge on an instance-group container.

pillSide.description: Which end of the top border the overlay pill sits on (only with `pillOverlay:true`). Default 'right', because the header (icon + label) owns the top-left corner; use 'left' on a wide container with a short label, or to stop two nested containers stacking their tags on the same corner.
